prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" personal injury attorney, but several top-rated firms in Chicago have proven track records for car accident claims, including Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C., Disparti Law Group, and Malman Law. Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. +2
When choosing an attorney for your car accident claim, comparing firms with extensive local experience, successful recovery histories, and contingency-fee structures (no upfront costs) is essential. Disparti Law Group Accident & Injury Lawyers +2
Experience & Results: Over 40 years in operation with more than $3.5 billion recovered total, including over 400 multi-million dollar verdicts and settlements.
Focus: Catastrophic injuries, wrongful death, and complex motor vehicle collisions.
Fee Structure: Free initial consultations and contingency-fee representation.
